authorInfo.bio: Ralph Keeler (1840–1873) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Vagabond Adventures" by Ralph Keeler is an autobiographical account written in the late 19th century. The book chronicles Keeler's life experiences as a young, adventurous boy who runs away from an unwelcoming home and embarks on various escapades, including life as a cabin boy on steamboats and his subsequent triumphs and tribulations.
